data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English ‘heah’ (high) + ‘ham’ (homestead, town). The name Hampton can be interpreted as ‘handsome town’. The name was common in England during the Middle Ages and was often given to children born in or near a town or settlement. The name Hampton carries the meaning “Handsome town” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Hampton usually hope their child will grow to embody handsome town and live with faith, good character and purpose.
